q: Is this site saying AI will kill everyone?
a: No. It shows what many serious researchers warn about, with their own sourced words, and also shows people who disagree. The goal is understanding and action, not fear.

q: What is AI control in one line?
a: Designing how we use powerful AI so that we stay safe even if the AI is secretly trying to cause harm.

q: I feel anxious after reading this. What should I do?
a: That is a normal reaction. Read the Staying steady lesson, pick one small action from the Prepare page, and talk to someone you trust. If it affects your sleep or daily life, please talk to a counsellor.
